text: Reacher heard the name and stopped moving.
It was not a name most people knew.
Reacher did not walk away.
He had been out of the Army for years.
The Army had not left him.
Some habits stayed in the bones.
You watched exits.
That was the wrong way to handle Reacher.
The old unit meant something to him.
Not sentiment.
He had a name, a bad feeling, and a direction to walk.
The first men came to warn him.
They did not say it that way.
Then he kept asking.
They met him in a room that smelled like old coffee and bad choices.
Two men sat across from him.
One talked.
One watched.
Reacher looked at him and said, "It is now.".
They had hoped to scare him off with words.
That failed.
The meeting was over.
They came for him after dark.
That made sense.
Then he stopped.
The first man came in loud.
Reacher let him get close enough to make the mistake complete, then one move dropped him.
The second man rushed from the left.
Reacher turned, stepped inside the swing, and put him down beside the first.
He was still coming.
The parking lot went quiet.
Reacher checked the men, not because he cared for them.
Reacher did not know yet, but the people hiding him knew Reacher was close.
Reacher found the place near the edge of town.
It looked ordinary from the outside.
Reacher kept walking.
The first guard told him to stop.
Reacher did not stop.
The second guard reached for him, and Reacher handled him first.
The first guard lasted longer.
"We are leaving.".
More men came before they reached the door.
That was expected.
Just one man going back for another.
